items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I have one that Joe Ollipurs gave you when I was a kid. ... The most mutes that I have, Joe Ollipurs gave to me.

ctx.x: Yeah, I hear all those guys. I heard Joe play that a long time before Louie. The funny thing, you play with a different band, you know them things out of the go, but you play it so wrong with different bands, and then you forget how to play it right.

Yeah. Did Joe play open match music? Oh yeah. He did play open a lot, huh? Oh yeah. He didn't always use some. He used to take one of those. What kind of different mutes did he use usually? What was that? What kind of mutes did he use? Those little con mutes, you can't buy them anymore. You can't buy them anymore. What did they look like? They're little tiny mutes. They're one of those. I have one of those. Oh, you have one of those. I have one that Joe Ollipurs gave you when I was a kid. That's the one. You have…
He had a kazooke, a big kazooke. He tied two of them together and had a blow and hold that kazooke. You know the kazooke where they blew the blow? Yes.
